title: Interactive Event System, Raycasting & Hit Testing Architecture

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/INTERACTIVE_EVENT_SYSTEM_AND_RAYCASTING_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/INTERACTIVE_EVENT_SYSTEM_AND_RAYCASTING_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Retiam includes a high-performance event dispatching and raycasting subsystem engineered to bridge physical user input (pointer, mouse, touch) to 2D and 3D scene graph entities rendered on WebGPU.
The system decouples low-level browser DOM events from scene entities through a three-tier architecture:

items: **[`InteractionManager`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/control/InteractionManager.ts)**: Central controller attached to the active [`Scene`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Scene.ts) and `<canvas>`. Listens to native browser pointer events, throttles motion sampling, tracks hover/drag state transitions, and coordinates raycasting.

**[`Raycaster`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/utils/Raycaster.ts)**: Mathematical ray generator and intersection engine implementing Möller–Trumbore triangle intersection, Slab-method AABB tests, and screen-space unprojection with camera matrix inversion.

**[`InteractionComponent`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/InteractionComponent.ts)**: Entity-attached ECS component declaring event callbacks, draggable flags, custom hit testing, cursor styles, and 3D plane projection constraints.

blocks.text: Before evaluating triangle meshes, candidate entities are culled via Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) intersection using the Kay-Kajiya slab algorithm:

blocks.tex: t_{\min, i} = \frac{\text{box}.\min_i - o_i}{d_i}, \quad t_{\max, i} = \frac{\text{box}.\max_i - o_i}{d_i} \quad (i \in \{x, y, z\})
t_{\text{enter}} = \max\Big(\min(t_{\min, x}, t_{\max, x}), \min(t_{\min, y}, t_{\max, y}), \min(t_{\min, z}, t_{\max, z})\Big)
t_{\text{exit}} = \min\Big(\max(t_{\min, x}, t_{\max, x}), \max(t_{\min, y}, t_{\max, y}), \max(t_{\min, z}, t_{\max, z})\Big)

blocks.text: This guarantees jitter-free 3D dragging across arbitrary viewing angles.

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Hovered: Pointer enters entity AABB/mesh
    Hovered --> Idle: Pointer leaves entity
    Hovered --> Dragging: PointerDown + DragThreshold exceeded
    Hovered --> Clicked: PointerDown + PointerUp without move
    Dragging --> Hovered: PointerUp
    Clicked --> Idle: Event dispatched

items: **Hover Tracking**: The manager maintains `hoveredEntity`. Moving between entities fires `onPointerLeave` on the previous target and `onPointerEnter` on the newly focused target.

**Click vs. Drag Disambiguation**: To prevent accidental clicks when panning or dragging, a movement threshold ($5\text{px}$) and timestamp window determine whether an action is dispatched as a click or initiates a drag session.
**Cursor Styling**: Each entity can declare a custom CSS cursor (`cursor: 'pointer' | 'grab' | 'text'`). The canvas cursor updates automatically on hover and resets on exit.
